measurementMethod: Independent visual pixel landmark picks on full native-resolution images and source-grid contact sheets. Coordinates use top-left origin and full image dimensions, not opaque bounding boxes. Landmark uncertainty is +-3 px normally, +-5 px for wing tips. Radius is proposed rig geometry because blades are removed; no measured blade radius claim.
